text:
I believe in my heart, a fragrant bough
that my Lord shakes like foliage,
perfuming all life with love
and making it blessed.


I believe in my heart, which asks
for nothing because it can dream the highest dream
and embraces all creation in that dream:
immense its dominion!


I believe in my heart, which when it sings
dives into the deep God, wounded and frank,
to rise from the living pool
newborn.


I believe in my heart, which trembles
because He made it, He who troubled the seas,
and in the One who gives Life its orchestrations
like the highest tides.


I believe in my heart, which I wring out
to dye life's canvas
red or pale, and which has made it
a glowing garment.


I believe in my heart, which in the sowing,
through the endless furrow, kept growing.
I believe in my heart, always poured out,
yet never emptied.


I believe in my heart, where the worm
will not bite, for it will blunt death;
I believe in my heart, resting
on the breast of mighty, terrible God.

translation.title: I Believe in My Heart
